newsitem.title: USA: New Horizon Kids Quest opens center.
newsitem.headline: New Horizon Kids Quest opens center.

text.p: New Horizon Kids Quest Inc said Thursday it opened a Kids Quest child-care center in a free-standing building adjacent to the Grand Casino Tunica in Robinsonville, Miss., near Memphis, Tenn.
The more than 22,000 square foot facility is the largest in the Kids Quest system and includes a retail area that features educational products and Kids Quest logo merchandise.

With this opening, New Horizon Kids Quest Inc has 10 locations operating in Nevada, Mississippi, Louisiana, Minnesota and Iowa, as well as contracts for an additional five locations. The company also operates 13 New Horizon Child Care centers in Idaho.
